summary_1line: Parvati creates Ganapati, Siva beheads then revives him with an elephant head, grants him primacy; later he wins lordship, marries Siddhi and Buddhi, and Siva destroys Tripura.

image_candidates.scene_text: Siva hurls his spear and Ganapati’s head is severed while the boy stands guarding Parvati’s bath door with a staff.
Siva attaches the elephant head of Gajasura onto the lifeless body of Ganapati as Parvati watches in grief and hope.
Siva rides a cosmic chariot made of Earth with sun and moon as wheels and fires a divine arrow that destroys the three floating cities of Tripura.
